verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at kling.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with substantive agent-readable content: RESTful API with JWT auth, global and China endpoints, model capabilities, per-unit pricing, and plan details. Agents can therefore be pointed straight at it, and the product also advertises an MCP/CLI route for agents. Missing for 10: no evidence of a fuller agent-oriented API reference (e.g., llms-full.txt or markdown endpoint schemas), and llms.txt content leans toward product and pricing summary rather than detailed integration docs.
